Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969–1976, Volume
                    E–7, Documents on South Asia, 1969–1972
122. Editorial Note
The political crisis in Pakistan, which escalated into civil war in East
                            Pakistan in March 1971, ultimately led to armed conflict between India
                            and Pakistan and convulsed the subcontinent of South Asia through the
                            end of the year. Most of the important documents bearing on the United
                            States response to that crisis are in
Foreign
                                Relations, 1969–1976, South Asia Crisis, 1971.
The documents in
                            this electronic publication for that period supplement, and should be
                            read in conjunction with, the printed volume.
